pages.title: Limits recede
pages.text: “The purpose of shackles is to restrain you. These work differently.”$(br2)The power of the Herald of Cold has changed the limits of your abilities. Shackles of the Edge expand their range.

pages.title: Power while equipped
pages.text: While equipped, Shackles of the Edge double the range of your abilities. This effect does not work while the item is unequipped.
